new_records.name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP), Maharashtra

authority.name: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra

version.title: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
version.summary: Back-ended capital subsidy of 15% to 35% on a bank loan for a new manufacturing, service or agro-based micro or small enterprise in Maharashtra.
version.objective: Create self-employment for young people in rural and urban Maharashtra by helping them set up new micro and small enterprises.
version.legal_basis: Government of Maharashtra scheme implemented by the Directorate of Industries through District Industries Centres and the Khadi and Village Industries Board.

conditions: Permanent resident (domicile) of Maharashtra
Aged 18 or above
Only new projects; existing units are not eligible
Only one person per family (self and spouse)
Must not have taken PMEGP or any other subsidy-linked government scheme
Class 8 pass needed for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakh (service)
Proprietorship, partnership or registered self-help group
exclusions: Units that already received a government subsidy under any central or state scheme

application.route: Apply online on maha-cmegp.gov.in; the District Industries Centre (urban) or the Khadi and Village Industries Board (rural) checks the application and sends it to a bank.
application.selection: District-level committee with the bank; the bank sanctions the loan and the subsidy is released after the stipulated period.

fine_print.review_note: Limits from the MAITRI page (revised ₹1 crore / ₹50 lakh). The original 2019 guideline used ₹50 lakh / ₹10 lakh and age 18–45 (+5 special); some banks may still apply the older limits.
fine_print.subsidy_rates: General: 15% urban, 25% rural, own share 10%. Special category (SC/ST, women, ex-servicemen, disabled): 25% urban, 35% rural, own share 5%.
fine_print.subsidy_caps: Subsidy capped at ₹17.5 lakh (manufacturing) and ₹7 lakh (service and agro).

benefit_summary.summary: 15–35% back-ended subsidy on projects up to ₹1 crore (manufacturing) or ₹50 lakh (service and agro).
benefit_summary.headline: 15–35% subsidy on a bank loan for a new unit

benefits.label: Back-ended capital subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost

requirements.name: Caste, validity or disability certificate (for special-category rates)

steps.title: Check eligibility and prepare a project report
steps.description: Confirm the project is new, within the cost limit, and that you have not taken PMEGP or another subsidy before.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.description: Fill the application on maha-cmegp.gov.in with your documents and project report.

steps.title: Committee review and bank sanction
steps.description: The DIC or KVIB forwards your application to a bank, which appraises and sanctions the loan.

steps.title: Set up the unit and receive the subsidy
steps.description: The subsidy is credited by the Directorate of Industries through the bank after the stipulated period.

windows.label: Applications are accepted on the portal through the year against district targets.

sources.title: MAITRI: CMEGP (Government of Maharashtra)
sources.anchor: For projects in manufacturing sectors the maximum project cost limit is Rs. 1 Cr and for service and agro-based sector it is Rs.50 Lakhs

new_records.name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA), Uttar Pradesh

authority.name: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Government of Uttar Pradesh

version.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA)
version.summary: Interest-free, collateral-free loan of up to ₹5 lakh with a 10% margin-money subsidy for young first-time entrepreneurs in Uttar Pradesh.
version.objective: Promote self-employment among educated and trained youth in Uttar Pradesh, aiming to create 10 lakh entrepreneurs in 10 years.
version.legal_basis: Government of Uttar Pradesh scheme implemented by the Directorate of Industries.

conditions: Resident of Uttar Pradesh
Aged 21 to 40
Class 8 pass, or a certified training, diploma or degree
Manufacturing, service or trade units
exclusions: Anyone availing another central or state loan-subsidy scheme

application.route: Register and apply on the UP MSME portal, uploading identity, age proof, training certificate and project report.

fine_print.review_note: Benefit text from the UP MSME 1-Connect scheme page; trained candidates under ODOP and Vishwakarma Shram Samman get preference.

benefit_summary.summary: Interest-free, collateral-free loan up to ₹5 lakh plus 10% margin-money subsidy.
benefit_summary.headline: Interest-free loan up to ₹5 lakh + 10% margin money

benefits.label: Interest-free, collateral-free loan up to ₹5 lakh
Margin-money subsidy of 10% of project cost

steps.title: Register on the UP MSME portal
Apply with documents
steps.description: Upload identity, age proof, training certificate and project report.

windows.label: Applications through the year on the UP MSME portal.

new_records.name: ODOP Financial Assistance (Margin Money) Scheme, Uttar Pradesh

authority.name: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Government of Uttar Pradesh

version.title: One District One Product (ODOP) Financial Assistance Scheme
version.summary: Margin money of up to 25% of project cost for units making their district's One District One Product item in Uttar Pradesh.
version.objective: Help units that make each district's identified ODOP product get bank finance by paying part of the project cost as margin money.
version.legal_basis: Government of Uttar Pradesh ODOP Financial Assistance (Margin Money) Scheme.

conditions: Unit must make the ODOP product identified for its own district (for example woodcraft in Saharanpur)
No minimum education is required
Industry, service and business sectors are covered
exclusions: Products that are not the district's identified ODOP product

application.route: Apply on the UP MSME portal; the District Industries Centre forwards applications to banks for loan sanction.

fine_print.slabs: Project up to ₹25 lakh: 25%, max ₹6.25 lakh. ₹25–50 lakh: ₹6.25 lakh or 20%, whichever is higher. ₹50–150 lakh: ₹10 lakh or 10%, whichever is higher. Above ₹150 lakh: 10%, max ₹20 lakh.

benefit_summary.summary: Margin money from 25% (max ₹6.25 lakh) down to 10% (max ₹20 lakh) depending on project size.
benefit_summary.headline: Up to 25% margin money for your district's ODOP product

benefits.label: Margin money of up to 25% of project cost (max ₹20 lakh for large projects)

requirements.name: Project report for the ODOP product

steps.title: Check your district's ODOP product
steps.description: The unit must make the product identified for your district.

steps.title: Apply on the UP MSME portal
Bank loan sanction and margin money release

version.title: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana
version.summary: Up to ₹10 lakh for a new unit in Bihar: 50% as a grant (max ₹5 lakh) and 50% as an interest-free loan (max ₹5 lakh), selected by lottery.
version.objective: Bring unemployed young men and women of Bihar into self-employment through six components for SC/ST, EBC, women, youth, minority and divyang applicants.
version.legal_basis: Industries Department, Government of Bihar; guideline for 2025-26 (Annexure-II).

conditions: Permanent resident of Bihar
Passed 10+2, intermediate, ITI, polytechnic diploma or equivalent
Aged 18 to 50
Unit set up as a proprietorship, partnership, LLP or private limited company
The unit must be in your home district
Only projects from the approved list

application.route: Apply online on udyami.bihar.gov.in during the annual window, choosing a project from the approved list.
application.selection: Computerised lottery against district targets, then document scrutiny.
application.window_note: The 2025-26 window ran from 25 February to 23 March 2026; the lottery was held on 20 May 2026. The next call has not been announced.

fine_print.components: SC/ST; EBC (BC-01, minorities excluded); women (all categories); youth (General and BC-02 men; 1% interest); minority; divyang (40%+ disability with UDID).
fine_print.release: 6-day training before the first instalment, paid into a current account in the unit's name.

benefit_summary.summary: Up to ₹10 lakh: 50% grant (max ₹5 lakh) and 50% interest-free loan (max ₹5 lakh).
benefit_summary.headline: Up to ₹10 lakh: ₹5 lakh grant + ₹5 lakh interest-free loan

benefits.label: Grant of 50% of project cost, max ₹5 lakh
Interest-free loan for the other 50%, max ₹5 lakh (1% interest for the youth component)

requirements.name: Matriculation certificate with date of birth

steps.title: Apply online in the annual window
6-day training
steps.description: Attend the non-residential training; two chances are given.

steps.title: Receive instalments
steps.description: Paid by RTGS/NEFT into a current account in the unit's name.

version.title: Bihar Laghu Udyami Yojana
version.summary: Grant of up to ₹2 lakh, paid in three instalments, for a member of an economically poor family in Bihar to start a small business.
version.objective: Give at least one member of each economically poor family identified in Bihar's caste-based survey a means of self-employment.
version.legal_basis: Industries Department, Government of Bihar, Resolution No. 256 dated 16 January 2024 (cabinet approval of the same date).

conditions: Aged 18 to 50 on the date of application
Resident of Bihar with a Bihar address on Aadhaar
Family income below ₹6,000 a month, with an income certificate
One person per family (husband, wife and unmarried children)

application.route: Apply online when the annual call opens on the Laghu Udyami portal.
application.selection: Computerised lottery in proportion to poor families by category; 20% kept on a waiting list.
application.window_note: Applications are invited once a year; the next call has not been announced.

fine_print.instalments: 25% of project cost, then 50%, then 25%; each released only after the previous one is properly used.

benefit_summary.summary: Grant up to ₹2 lakh in three instalments.
benefit_summary.headline: Grant up to ₹2 lakh for a small business

benefits.label: Grant up to ₹2 lakh in three instalments (25% / 50% / 25%)

steps.title: Register when the annual call opens

steps.description: Each instalment follows proper use of the previous one.
